summary.text: Valarie Hodges is a Republican member of the Louisiana State Senate for District 13, which represents Livingston Parish, and was first elected to the Senate in 2023. Her official Senate page lists her as Vice Chair of the Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Senate page lists Hodges' education as Glen Oaks High School in Baton Rouge, the Bob Brooks School of Real Estate, Light University course work and Louisiana State University.
It lists her committees as Education (Vice Chair), Health and Welfare, Judiciary C, Retirement and the Senate Select Committee on Women and Children.
It also lists her in the Capital Region Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus and the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
